preserved_paths: page rectangles are subtracted before desktop fill
document layout paints after desktop fill
LibreOfficeKit tiled rendering skips desktop fill
print and metafile output retain their existing exclusions
high contrast and non-Material themes retain configured colors
zoom, selection, caret, input coordinates, and document pixels are unchanged
note: Material mode now has a Writer-owned canvas consumer rather than relying on generic workspace plumbing. The helper is high-contrast-first, exact-theme-gated, accent/dark aware through MaterialTokens::fromCurrentTheme, and falls back to the configured AppBackground color if tokens cannot load. PaintDesktop subtracts every visible page (plus the notes sidebar) before PaintDesktop_ fills only the remaining canvas region. Page-shadow seam clearing uses the same resolved color. The document layout, page contents, tiled/print paths, selection, caret, zoom, and coordinates are untouched. Source evidence only; runtime pixels remain unverified.
